object_description: three-building ensemble around elevated exterior galleries
design_condition: The ensemble is placed south of the perimeter to extend the linear park, with a separate northern housing volume intended to protect the school from cold winds, while paths and courtyards connect the buildings.

positive.statement: The aerial courtyard system has strong spatial qualities and useful visual framing of the landscape.

position.rationale: Top view shows separated elevated courtyard-like frames, supported by layered elevations.

positive.statement: The galleries create transparencies that place the different parts in visual relationship.

position.rationale: Repeated horizontal bands and separated masses indicate gallery connections.

positive.statement: The architectural writing is original and skillful in its constructive expressionism.

position.rationale: Architectural expression is a whole-design judgment without one exclusive marker.

positive.statement: The different parts of the program are well organized with spaces of specific character.

position.rationale: Top view distinctly separates three program masses with differing levels.

negative.statement: The exposed north-facing galleries create doubts about their use under the local climatic conditions.

position.rationale: North-facing gallery condition is constrained on the northern perimeter and elevated bands.

negative.statement: The size of the workforce may prevent the galleries from functioning as courtyards, weakening their reason for being.

position.rationale: Anchor follows the elevated central connecting zone.

negative.statement: The ground-level courtyards are unconvincing in their position and size and disrupt fluid movement between buildings.

position.rationale: Separate ground-level open spaces are visible between masses.

negative.statement: The residential building's positioning and sizing are ambiguous, and its wind-protection role lacks credibility.

position.rationale: Separate northern mass is visible in plan and north elevation.

negative.statement: The park structure has not evolved sufficiently, while the paths appear dictated only by service functions and the planting project lacks substance.

position.rationale: Sparse landscape geometry supports only a broad exterior-region anchor.

negative.statement: The bowl at the junction of the main student flows and a major road does not seem appropriate.

position.rationale: Bowl is not identifiable; approximate a low edge zone for converging flows.
